notes: The Sensu route: Home now has a slim edge tab — swipe in from the edge and the controls pie blooms where your thumb lands. Slide onto Flashlight, Ring, Reach or All apps and let go; grab the rim arcs to scrub brightness (bottom) and volume (top); the centre shows the clock, or the control you're on. Same pie as Controls anywhere, same sizes and feel. The Orb's left pull opens it too; the old fan is retired. Tab side follows the Controls anywhere handle side; turn the tab off in Settings > Device & setup > Controls anywhere.
